name: Pull Request
description: Submit changes to the codebase
title: "[PR] "
labels: []
assignees: []

## Summary
Brief description of the changes in this PR.

## Type of Change
What type of change does this PR introduce?
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Breaking change
- [ ] Refactoring
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Performance improvement
- [ ] Test coverage

## Testing
How was this change tested?
- [ ] Unit tests added/updated
- [ ] Integration tests added/updated
- [ ] Manual testing performed
- [ ] No tests needed (please explain)

## Checklist

### Code Quality
- [ ] Code follows the project's style guidelines
- [ ] Self-review completed
- [ ] Comments added for complex logic
- [ ] No new warnings or errors
- [ ] No `console.log` or debugging code

### Documentation
- [ ] README updated (if applicable)
- [ ] Technical docs updated (if applicable)
- [ ] API changes documented (if applicable)
- [ ] JSDoc comments added/updated (if applicable)

### Security (if applicable)
- [ ] No secrets or credentials committed
- [ ] Input validation added
- [ ] Authentication/authorization checks reviewed
- [ ] OAuth scopes properly handled

### Git
- [ ] Commits follow Conventional Commits format
- [ ] Branch is up to date with target branch
- [ ] No merge conflicts

## Related Issues
Link any related issues using keywords:
- Closes #
- Fixes #
- Resolves #

## Additional Context
Any other information about the PR that reviewers should know.
